title: A gating finding becomes a tick in the running epic, with no person
description:
The absorption itself: the step that today only a person can take. ticfac findings ends its listing with 'N waiting for a person; the epic's close-out does not hand over while a finding is untriaged', and this tick is what takes the person out of the common path.

The MECHANISM already exists - triage's --promote-as turns a finding into a tick, her added --fixed-as for a repair made inside the epic, aqm moved the untriaged gate from every tick to the close-out. What is added here is the automatic verdict, driven by pzp's observation or bse's prediction, and the recording that makes it legitimate.

AXIOM 1 IS THE HARD PART, not the promotion. Absorbing changes the epic's shape mid-run: new ticks, new waves, a different graph than the one the run started with. A cold reconstruction from git must reach the SAME epic, which means the absorbed tick AND the reasoning that absorbed it - the item id, the verdict, observed or predicted, the confidence if predicted - are on the run branch as a decision record, not merely in the tracker. A re-derivation that reaches a smaller epic than the warm run is the failure this tick must not have.

The absorbed tick is placed so it is fixed BEFORE the items it gates are asserted, which in practice means before the final review rather than appended after it. A fix that lands after the review it invalidates has not been absorbed, it has been appended.

WHAT STAYS: a finding the done is reachable without is still a backlog tick with an owner, and it is still reported. Unattended means nobody has to be there, not that nobody is ever told.
acceptance_criteria: A finding judged gating is promoted into the running epic as a tick with no person triaging, placed before the final review; the absorption decision - item id, verdict, observed or predicted, confidence - is a decision record on the run branch; a cold re-derivation from git reaches the same epic graph as the warm run, proven by a test that kills and re-derives; a non-gating finding still becomes a backlog tick with an owner; and go test -short ./... passes
